title: Drummer Norm Downs and Baby Dodds
summary: Dominique praises Baby Dodds and tells how Baby introduced him to the drummer Norm Downs, who impressed him at a dance and show.

story.theme_name: Drummers and drumming: who played what, and how
story.community_name: Great drummers: who they admired and why
